newsitem.title: FINLAND: ILKKA SEES LOWER NEWSPRINT PRICE IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: ILKKA SEES LOWER NEWSPRINT PRICE IN 1997.

text.p: Finnish media group Ilkka Oy expects the average newsprint price to fall four to five percent in 1997 on 1996, CEO Erkki Poranen said on Thursday.
"It will be four to five percent lower," Poranen told Reuters by telephone, when asked about prospects for newsprint prices.
Poranen said he based his view on negotiations over Ilkka's newsprint purchases for the first half of 1997.
Newsprint prices are expected to turn higher late in 1997 or in 1998, he said.
Ilkka is a publisher of nine regional or local newspapers.
